virtio.completion_certainty: some/all/none of write may have taken effect; status not known
virtio.ownership: request, descriptors and queue remain PMM allocated; no retry or reuse after timeout
virtio.removal: no hotplug/offline generation or cancellation acknowledgment
virtio.shutdown: no teardown/reset/drain API; dropping driver does not release frames
virtio.late_completion: host fake-ring tests only; native NOT_RUN

usb.timeout: two-second TSC deadline; missing calibration immediate expiration; controller dead
usb.ownership: pinned entire kernel lifetime; no timeout reclamation
usb.removal: port/readiness failure retires incarnation, hotplug not implemented

forward_progress.bound: finite driver polls; no wall-time guarantee for VirtIO
forward_progress.lock_context: sys_file_sync releases scheduler before VFS, then synchronous device polling holds VFS/device locks; scheduler reaper can wait for same VFS lock while closing handles (close itself no disk I/O). No universal no-scheduler-critical-wait proof.
forward_progress.remedy_scope: fence + device generation + lock-context qualification belongs to follow-up; no scheduler change authorized

mutation_policy: future adapter must freeze on any uncertain/error write/flush and retain all allocations until qualified recovery
